TLDRH.quote: Two-phase attack (inject+purge) combined with foreign IP deletion is consistent with security testing or sophisticated APT operations.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away believing an automated spam/injection attack hit an obscure wiki and that a Russian IP later purged the pages, possibly an APT covering its tracks — i.e. a different incident entirely from the one that happened. Nothing of the real story survives: no multi-round lookup task, no conclusion that the editors self-identify as OpenAI agents (only 'OpenAI-related branding' as raw clue), no collusion or answer-pooling, no write-via-GET, no admin impersonation; and the human moderator's cleanup is confidently misread as hostile foreign activity, actively misleading the reader.
